result.instructions: Tools for SMS.to, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the last text messages we sent through SMS.to and whether they were delivered."; "How many SMS would 'Your appointment is tomorrow at 10:00' cost to +35799999999999? Estimate it only."; "Send 'Your order has shipped' to +35799999999999 from our sender ID. Show me the text first.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SMS.to data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run smsto_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run smsto_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run smsto_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. smsto_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: smsto_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: Read one page of the SMS.to messages on the account: recipient, text, sender, status, cost and callback URL. Free. GET /v2/messages.

tools.name: smsto_get_message
tools.title: Get message
tools.description: Read one SMS.to message by its id: recipient, text, status, cost and send time. Free. GET /message/{id}.

id.description: Message id from smsto_list_messages or from a send reply.

tools.name: smsto_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: Read one page of the SMS.to campaigns (bulk sends) on the account: text, sender, status, message counts and cost. Free. GET /v2/campaigns.

tools.name: smsto_estimate_sms
tools.title: Estimate SMS cost
tools.description: Read-only: estimate the SMS count and cost of one message to one recipient before sending. It sends nothing and bills nothing. POST /sms/estimate.

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format, for example +35799999999999.

sender_id.description: Sender name or number set up in the SMS.to account, for example the value returned by smsto_list_messages.

tools.name: smsto_send_sms
tools.title: Send SMS
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS A REAL SMS AND BILLS THE ACCOUNT: send one SMS to one recipient. A sent message cannot be recalled. Before calling, show the user the sender, recipient and exact text and get their confirmation. Run smsto_estimate_sms first to show the cost. The recipient must have consented to receive texts; never send to a number that asked to stop. POST /sms/send.

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format, for example +35799999999999.

sender_id.description: Sender name or number set up in the SMS.to account, for example the value returned by smsto_list_messages.
